body:
Direct employer-scan feedback: Skills section was one flat, alphabetically-arbitrary list. New Skill.Category field + resume.GroupSkillsByCategory (shared by PDF export and screen preview), grouped rendering in both, and POST /resume/skills/categorize -- real Vertex AI auto-categorization reusing IDUNA's own GFD Item Builder credential/call pattern exactly (gcloud ADC, gemini-2.5-flash, responseMimeType JSON). Idempotent by design. New unit + handler tests, OpenAPI spec updated, fresh-SQLite live boot re-verified. Honest gap: the live Vertex call itself wasn't exercised end to end in this sandbox (no active gcloud account).

⚓ ☃
title: Community Tools: Skills grouped by category + real Vertex AI auto-categorize
